Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Restarts a custom scan in place when the executor rescans it, such as the inner side of a nested loop.

```csharp
public interface IPgRescannableCustomScan<TState> : IPgCustomScan<TState> where TState : class
```

Type parameters:

`TState`

The per-scan state.

Without this capability, Ankus disposes the state and calls [Begin(PgCustomScanContext)](/api/ankus.ipgcustomscan-1/#member-3882d047fcb8947b) again.

## Methods

<a id="member-3e1a9c59285f71f9"></a>

### Rescan(TState)

Restarts the scan so the next call to [Read(TState, PgHeapTuple)](/api/ankus.ipgcustomscan-1/#member-00a31a433c3a9564) returns its first row.
